## Intended function

Separate signal, TIME and RANGE mux banks with shared four-bit address

## Recorded findings

16:1 analog multiplexer; enable HIGH disconnects all channels.

The 80 ohm headline is not a guaranteed 3.3 V on-resistance; do not use it as such.
